##### Project general facts

Sudara presents a refined architectural concept that blends contemporary elegance with the rich heritage of Thai hospitality, set in the vibrant area of ​​Bangtao Beach. The design is led by a vision of seamless integration between modern living and nature, combining sleek architectural lines with natural materials, lush landscaping, and open, airy spaces. At the heart of the project lies The Pavilion, a thoughtfully designed central hub surrounded by greenery and water features, creating a harmonious environment that fosters both privacy and community while embracing a true resort-style atmosphere.

The project offers an extensive collection of amenities and services designed to elevate everyday living. Residents can enjoy multiple swimming pools, including a large tropical lagoon-style pool, a fitness center, yoga terrace, rooftop lounge, co-working spaces, café, and a dedicated kids’ club. The development also features landscaped outdoor areas, multifunctional spaces, and a secure gated environment with 24/7 security. A key highlight is the professional management by the team of Andara Resort & Villas, providing concierge services, housekeeping, rental management, and personalized lifestyle experiences, ensuring a seamless blend of comfort, convenience, and luxury.

The residences include a diverse range of layouts, from one- to three-bedroom apartments, as well as select units with private gardens and plunge pools. Each residence is designed with a focus on spaciousness, natural light, and functional living, complemented by modern interiors and high-quality finishes. The use of carefully selected materials, energy-efficient solutions, and contemporary design elements creates elegant and comfortable living spaces. Large windows and sliding glass doors enhance indoor-outdoor living, while fully equipped kitchens and thoughtfully planned layouts make the residences ideal for both personal use and investment purposes.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Bangtao Beach is one of the most desirable coastal areas in Phuket, known for its long stretch of soft surroundings and calm, upscale atmosphere. Unlike more crowded parts of the island, Bangtao offers a balanced lifestyle where tranquility meets sophistication. The area is home to high-end resorts, beach clubs, and private residences, creating an environment that appeals to both holidaymakers and long-term residents seeking a more refined coastal experience.

The location is rich in lifestyle and infrastructure, making everyday living exceptionally convenient. Residents have access to premium destinations such as Boat Avenue Phuket and Central Porto de Phuket, offering a wide range of international restaurants, boutiques, and supermarkets. The area also features world-class facilities including golf courses, wellness centers, and international schools, making it particularly attractive for families and expatriates looking for comfort and quality of life.

Bangtao also stands out for its strong investment potential and accessibility. Located within easy reach of Phuket International Airport, it ensures convenient travel connections while maintaining a peaceful setting. The area consistently demonstrates high rental demand, especially in the short-term luxury segment, supported by its popularity among international tourists. This combination of natural beauty, developed infrastructure, and stable demand positions Bangtao as one of the most promising locations in Phuket for both lifestyle and investment purposes.
